headline: Know what to study today until your exam.
stepLanguageHint: Adapts academic terminology and suggested grading scale.

welcomeSlides.overviewDesc: Turn your courses, timetable, and exam dates into realistic study blocks for today — calmly and with zero guesswork.
welcomeSlides.cycleDesc: From your daily schedule to distraction-free focus, your Uni Notebook, and automatic spaced repetition in one flow.
welcomeSlides.planDesc: Import your degree, test dates, and schedules by text or screenshot and watch your weekly plan adapt.
welcomeSlides.focusDesc: Timed focus blocks paired with smart spaced repetition (1→3→7→21 days) that adapts upcoming sessions.
welcomeSlides.unisDesc: Pick the shape, name, and teaching style of each Uni. Evolves from Egg to Master strictly through verified mastery.

s2.title: Your degree and semester
s2.intro: Choose your school or university, degree, year and current semester. We work out your starting point automatically.
s2.schoolPh: E.g. University of Porto, High school…
s2.customise: Customise ECTS credits, challenges and extras (optional)
s2.supportAreas: Where do you want more help from Uni?

s3.title: Your courses
s3.intro: Mark what you're taking now, have finished or will take later. You can also import your timetable.

s3.pasteHint: Paste the course list from your student portal, or type one course per line:

s4.title: Your weekly rhythm
s4.intro: Choose how much time to study on your available days.
s4.hardHint: The planner gives extra priority and shorter blocks to the courses you pick here.
s4.notesPh: E.g. I need extra help with series or physics before tests
s4.mailBody: You can connect your school email to see important notices in Today, or do it later in Settings.
s4.privacyTitle: Privacy and control of your data
s4.ageBody: I confirm I am at least {{age}} or have permission from my parent or guardian.
s4.ageError: Confirm the minimum age above to continue.
s4.aiTitle: Turn on the AI Uni Tutor (optional):
s4.aiBody: lets Uni answer questions, create review challenges and read screenshots you send. Your data is used only for your studies.

s4.cloudLater: if you sign in later, syncs your notebook between phone and computer.

caloiro_inicio.title: First year · Start of semester
caloiro_inicio.description: No timetable, exam dates or shared Drives yet.
caloiro_inicio.message: Welcome to your first semester! Even without a timetable, test dates or notes yet, I'll create a light Kick-off Plan for your courses — and keep this Hub ready to connect everything as soon as it's out.

caloiro_meio.title: First year · Mid-semester
caloiro_meio.description: You have classes and exam dates, but few documents or Drives.
caloiro_meio.message: Since the semester has started, the key is confirming your timetable and upcoming test dates so the plan prioritises what's due first. Then we'll add your lecturers' PDFs and Drives.

veterano_inicio.title: Returning · Start of semester
veterano_inicio.description: You have folders, Drives or external notebooks; timetable and tests are missing.
veterano_inicio.message: Nice! While the timetable and official assessment calendar aren't out yet, connect your shared Drives, local PDFs and portals to gather everything in one Hub and build a steady plan.

veterano_meio.title: Returning · Mid-semester
veterano_meio.description: Bring together timetable, tests, shared Drives, local files and portals.
veterano_meio.message: Let's gather your whole semester in one place: university timetable, assessment dates, classmates' shared Drives, official PDFs from your disk and Uni's Notebook.
